transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

I’ve been having a harder time since my sister and her baby moved back home. I’m more on edge and kind of down, and I’ve been snapping over little things at home. Then I get to class or the shop already drained. I’m still managing mostly, but I missed a couple deadlines and backed out of helping with the theater set because I couldn’t keep everything straight.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
About a month now—basically since my sister and her baby moved back into the house.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy doing?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a big change in that.
Have you been feeling down or depressed for most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d say most of the day, nearly every day. I’ve just been more stressed and on edge lately.
Have you noticed any physical symptoms when you feel on edge, like a racing heart, sweating, or an upset stomach?
I haven’t really noticed anything like that. Mostly I just feel tense and irritated.
